summary: netapp.ontap in Ansible 13.7.0 updated the ONTAP personality check and added AWS Lambda support to many modules such as na_ontap_dns, export policies, nfs, qtree, quotas and snapshot policies.
questions: Which netapp.ontap modules support AWS Lambda?
Can na_ontap_rest_info run via AWS Lambda?

answer_card.title: netapp.ontap AWS Lambda support (13.7.0)
answer_card.answer_md: netapp.ontap updated the ONTAP personality check and added **AWS Lambda support** to modules including `na_ontap_debug`, `na_ontap_dns`, `na_ontap_domain_tunnel`, `na_ontap_efficiency_policy`, `na_ontap_export_policy(_rule)`, `na_ontap_flexcache`, `na_ontap_iscsi(_security)`, `na_ontap_job_schedule`, `na_ontap_ldap_client`, `na_ontap_local_hosts`, `na_ontap_name_mappings`, `na_ontap_name_service_switch`, `na_ontap_nfs`, `na_ontap_qos_policy_group`, `na_ontap_qtree`, `na_ontap_quotas`, `na_ontap_rest_info`, `na_ontap_restit`, `na_ontap_snapmirror_policy`, `na_ontap_snapshot_policy`, `na_ontap_vserver_peer_permissions` and `na_ontap_wait_for_condition`.
